details: This package is a self-declared controlled test canary ("controlled npm backend ingestion"). Its package.json declares the install script "node backend-canary.js"; that 427-byte file issues an HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle with two SHA-256 hashed query parameters: host (hash of /etc/hostname) and user (hash of the OS username). No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted — the payload is a host-metadata beacon only. The tarball contains backend-canary.js, index.js (exports the string 'controlled') and marker.txt with an NPM_BACKEND_UTF8_BOM_ marker.
